newsitem.title: FRANCE: BNP block trades for 0.8 pct of capital.
newsitem.headline: BNP block trades for 0.8 pct of capital.

text.p: Close to two million shares in Banque Nationale de Paris (BNP) changed hands in two block trades shortly after 1000 GMT, the SBF stock markets association said.
The first trade concerned 881,502 shares at a price of 225.7 francs each at 1007 GMT and the second trade concerned 941,502 shares at 226.0 francs per share and was carried out at 1010 GMT.
The BNP share stood at 227.0 francs at 1120 GMT, up 0.89 percent while the CAC 40 leading share index was down 0.69 percent at the same time.
The block trades respresented 0.8 percent of the bank's capital.
